Info magang dari Domino's

Hi, DomiZen!🍕 We're currently looking for an HR People & Culture Intern with a focus on Employer Branding & Employee Engagement.

Responsibilities:
• Support People & Culture initiatives through data management, reporting, and administrative tasks.
• Create internal communication and employer branding materials, including posters and presentation decks.
• Assist in the execution of employee engagement programs, corporate culture initiatives, and internal campaigns.
• Demonstrate strong analytical thinking, adaptability, and a fast-learning mindset in supporting various HR projects and business needs.

📍 Be part of our journey in building a positive and thriving workplace!

📩 Send your CV now and don't miss this opportunity!
